subject: showcase
caption:
Every couple has a version of the same story. Where they met, who spoke first, how long it took.

Jed and Steph put theirs on the page, in their own words. We blurred it here because that part belongs to them, not to our feed.

Guests read it before they read anything else. Nobody scrolls past the story to get to the map.

If you are planning yours, message us the date and we will show you where your words would sit.
